notes.title: The Willow Man - Even More Updates/Japanese Translation
notes.content:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43764467/f8150225f3377c6b1514dfba7407a46d809f7060.jpg
Hey everyone just here once again to mention more updates I have made to “The Willow Man”. Again I would like to seriously thank everyone who has given me a chance and checked out the game. It means so much to me to be given even a chance of your time so again thank you. Now moving on we have some big changes here in this update without further a due here are the current changes to the game.

Featured Changes:

 Game is now fully playable in Japanese!


 Made changes to being in low sanity state to be less overwhelming.


 Adjusted blocking, dodge, fighting timings.


 Added a visual to hiding in closets, and adjusted timings to exiting hiding spots.

 Fixed spelling errors in the text.


 Added some more VFX to game.


 Fixed some more minor bugs that lead to a more smoother experiences.

notes.title: New Update For The WIllow Man
notes.content:
Hey everyone just here to mention some updates I have made for “The Willow Man”. Firstly to everyone who has given me a chance and checked out the game. It really means a lot to me to have anyone even give me chance so again thank you. Now enough mush lets move onto the changes to the current build of “The Willow Man”.

Featured Changes:


 New Player Controls displayed between Keyboard & Xbox Controller. Helps with well showing you how to play. Exciting I know…


 New Tutorial showing how to play and hide from The Willow Man.


 New Balance Changes to being chased by The Willow Man. More chances to escape his evil grasp.


 New Animations/Props Added to Environment.


 Fixed some minor bugs that lead to a more smoother experience overall.

notes.title: Update For Willow Man - Small Update
notes.content: Hey everyone just letting you know about a new patch for "The Willow Man". Fixed the UI scaling issues of well the player controls images.  So now instead of being greeted with a picture of a note pad with instructions on how to control player. You are greeted with a nice image all the player controls with all button prompts in place for both keyboard and game pad. Anyway thanks to everyone who took the time to even try the game. It means the world to me. Remember never stop dreaming everyone.
